notes: Bitforge: a single-file, offline pixel-art studio. Layered non-destructive editing with exact integer alpha compositing and 8 blend modes, 10 tools (pencil/eraser/fill/line/rect/ellipse/marquee/move/eyedropper/hand), pixel-perfect pencil, symmetry, selection cut/copy/paste/flip/nudge, full undo/redo, canvas resize/scale, layer ops, GPU-cached smooth zoom/pan + pinch, devicePixelRatio rendering, generated sample art, opens real images & project JSON, drag-and-drop, exports PNG/SVG/JSON, autosave to guarded localStorage, synthesized Web Audio UI sounds, keyboard shortcuts, reduced-motion + touch support. Known limitation: blend-mode SVG export is approximate in some renderers.
